user.title: Sign in to Vestel Smart Life
user.description: Use your Vestel Akıllı Yaşam / Smart Life account, then select your existing home. This is not the Tuya Smart Life app.

home.title: Select your home
home.description: Supported appliances in this home will be discovered automatically.

error.invalid_auth: Unable to sign in. Check your email and password.
error.invalid_home: Select a home from the list.

abort.no_homes: No homes found. Add your appliances in the Smart Life app first.

unsupported_devices.title: Unsupported Vestel device types
unsupported_devices.description: This home contains {count} unsupported devices. Types: {device_types}. No controls were created for them; supported devices continue to work. Legacy controls: AC, WD, DW, RF; experimental controls: WM, FD; monitoring only: TD, OV.

incompatible_devices.title: Incompatible Vestel model description
incompatible_devices.description: {count} device or control descriptions are incompatible with this release. Affected controls were skipped; other devices continue to work. Download redacted diagnostics from the integration menu to help add model support.

apply.name: Apply appliance setting
apply.description: Apply a discovery-defined setting or command; raw commands are not accepted.

get_consumption.name: Get consumption history
get_consumption.description: Read estimated energy, cost and water history without changing appliance settings.

get_billing_settings.name: Get billing estimate settings
get_billing_settings.description: Read the device limit and home tariff and unit-price settings.

set_bill_limit.name: Set bill limit
set_bill_limit.description: Change the selected device or home estimate limit. The other scope is preserved.

set_energy_price.name: Set energy price
set_energy_price.description: Change the kWh price and currency for all estimates in this home, not the electricity supplier contract.

set_subscriber_type.name: Set subscriber type
set_subscriber_type.description: Change the subscriber type used for this home’s billing estimates.

set_tariff_type.name: Set tariff type
set_tariff_type.description: Change this home’s estimate tariff to one-time or three-time.

set_energy_management.name: Set energy management
set_energy_management.description: Enable or disable the home’s billing estimate feature; this does not turn appliances on or off.
